diary.days.title: Days
diary.days.empty: Nothing to write yet. In the evening I'll write how the day went.
diary.day.festival.one.0: Today was {0}. The whole town came out.
diary.day.festival.one.1: A holiday: {0}. Even the grown-ups acted like kids.
diary.day.festival.plain.0: There was a holiday in town; everyone was outside.
diary.day.festival.plain.1: A holiday today. Noise, flags, music till evening.
diary.day.festival.plain.2: A festival day. It was fun, even if I didn't get all of it.
diary.day.bird_friend.one.0: A bird ate from my hand: {0}! My heart was pounding.
diary.day.bird_friend.one.1: I have a new friend: {0}. Ate right out of my hand.
diary.day.bird_friend.one.2: I tamed a bird. {0}, that's who it was.
diary.day.bird_friend.plain.0: A bird ate from my palm. I held my breath not to scare it.
diary.day.bird_friend.plain.1: A bird landed on my hand and ate. Wow.
diary.day.bird_friend.plain.2: One more bird knows me now.
diary.day.bird_new.one.0: A new bird for my book: {0}.
diary.day.bird_new.one.1: Saw a bird I'd never met before: {0}.
diary.day.bird_new.one.2: Wrote it in the bird book: {0}. Watched it for ages.
diary.day.bird_new.plain.0: Met a new bird and wrote it down.
diary.day.bird_new.plain.1: The bird book got one more page.
diary.day.bird_new.plain.2: Looked through the binoculars and found a bird I didn't have yet.
diary.day.fish.one.2: Pulled out a fish: {0}. My hands still smell of the sea.
diary.day.fish.plain.0: Sat with the rod. Caught something.
diary.day.fish.plain.1: Went fishing. The water was cold and the fish sly.
diary.day.fish.plain.2: Caught a fish. Not huge, but mine.
diary.day.job.plain.0: Did a bit of work. A little money and sore feet.
diary.day.job.plain.1: Worked today. The pay is small, but it's pay.
diary.day.job.plain.2: Did a job; got it signed in my work book.
diary.day.job.plain.3: Turns out work is kind of interesting. Sometimes.
diary.day.win.plain.0: I won! Didn't expect it myself.
diary.day.win.plain.2: Beat everyone who was there. Well, almost.
diary.day.film.one.0: Watched a film: “{0}”. Old, but funny.
diary.day.film.one.1: The cinema showed “{0}”. Stayed to the last frame.
diary.day.film.one.2: A film: “{0}”. Silent, but you get it all.
diary.day.film.plain.0: Went to the cinema. In the dark it smells of dust and sunflower seeds.
diary.day.film.plain.1: Watched an old film. The people in it walk fast and funny.
diary.day.film.plain.2: Went to the pictures. Squinted at the sun for ages after.
diary.day.bird_self.plain.0: Was a bird again. From up there the town is tiny.
diary.day.bird_self.plain.1: Flew. The wind holds you better than you'd think.
diary.day.bird_self.plain.2: Was a bird for a while. Coming back to legs felt odd.
diary.day.kite.plain.0: Flew a kite. It tugged upward like it was alive.
diary.day.kite.plain.1: The kite stayed up a long time. My arms got tired holding the line.
diary.day.kite.plain.2: The wind was just right; the kite went up high.
diary.day.letter.plain.0: Wrote a letter and dropped it in the box. Now I wait.
diary.day.letter.plain.1: Sent a postcard. Wonder when it'll get there.
diary.day.letter.plain.2: Spent longer on a letter than I thought I would.
diary.day.sky.plain.0: Looked through a telescope. There's so much up there it makes me dizzy.
diary.day.sky.plain.1: A telescope shows what eyes can't. Wrote down what I found.
diary.day.sky.plain.2: Studied the sky through the tube. I want more.
diary.day.corvid_gift.plain.0: The crows brought me a present. I think we're friends.
diary.day.corvid_gift.plain.1: Found what a crow had hidden. Or did it leave it for me?
diary.day.corvid_gift.plain.2: Corvids are complicated. But today they were kind.
diary.day.corvid_snatch.plain.0: A crow snatched food right from under my nose. Cheeky thing.
diary.day.corvid_snatch.plain.1: The crows nicked something again. I'll be more careful.
diary.day.corvid_snatch.plain.2: A crow outsmarted me. Annoying how neatly.
diary.day.music.plain.0: Played a tune. Almost without mistakes.
diary.day.music.plain.1: Practised music. My fingers don't obey yet.
diary.day.music.plain.2: I played, and someone even stopped to listen.
diary.day.garden.plain.0: Pottered about the allotment. Dirt under my nails.
diary.day.garden.plain.1: Something came up in my bed. Grew it myself!
diary.day.garden.plain.2: Weeded, watered, picked. An allotment is work.
diary.day.aton.plain.0: Was at the lab in Academgorodok. Understood nothing, but it was interesting.
diary.day.aton.plain.1: Fiddled with the lab's instruments. They hum like they're alive.
diary.day.aton.plain.2: In Academgorodok everything blinks and beeps. I like it.
diary.day.people.one.1: Got chatting: {0} told me all sorts.
diary.day.people.many.0: Chatted {1} times today: {0}. I think we're pals.
diary.day.people.plain.0: Talked to people. The town is slowly becoming mine.
diary.day.people.plain.1: Talked a lot today. My tongue is tired.
diary.day.people.plain.2: Met someone new. The names get mixed up.
diary.day.book.plain.0: Read a book. Couldn't put it down.
diary.day.book.plain.1: Borrowed a book from the library. It smells of old paper.
diary.day.book.plain.2: Sat on a bench and read till it got dark.
diary.day.sanatorium.plain.0: Was at the sanatorium. Treatments, quiet, everyone in slippers.
diary.day.sanatorium.plain.1: Quiet hour at the sanatorium. I honestly lay still. Almost.
diary.day.sanatorium.plain.2: The sanatorium: an oxygen cocktail and the guests' talk.
diary.day.haircut.plain.0: Got a haircut. The back of my neck feels cold.
diary.day.haircut.plain.1: Went to the barber. Some other me in the mirror.
diary.day.haircut.plain.2: A new haircut. Let's see if anyone notices.
diary.day.feeder.one.0: A bird came to the feeder: {0}.
diary.day.feeder.one.1: A guest at the feeder today: {0}.
diary.day.feeder.one.2: The feeder works! In came a bird: {0}.
diary.day.feeder.plain.1: Watched who eats at the feeder. A whole queue.
diary.day.feeder.plain.2: Topped up the feed, and the birds didn't keep me waiting.
diary.day.photo.plain.0: Took photos. I'll see what came out when I develop them.
diary.day.photo.plain.1: Clicked the camera. Have to save film.
diary.day.photo.plain.2: Was at the photo studio. Smells of chemicals and old pictures.
diary.day.place.one.0: Got here for the first time: {0}.
diary.day.place.one.1: A new place on my map: {0}.
diary.day.place.one.2: Found a place I'd never been: {0}.
diary.day.place.plain.1: Marked a new place on the map.
diary.day.place.plain.2: The town is bigger than I thought. Found a new corner today.
diary.day.games.plain.0: Played chess. Thought long, lost fast.
diary.day.games.plain.1: Played a game or two. The old men at the board are tough.
diary.day.records.plain.0: Listened to records. The needle hisses, but the music is good.
diary.day.records.plain.1: Put on a record and just sat there.
diary.day.records.plain.2: Dropped a coin in the jukebox.
diary.day.tea.plain.0: Had tea at someone's place. There were bagels.
diary.day.tea.plain.1: Tea with jam: the best thing all day.
diary.day.tea.plain.2: We sat over tea and talked about everything.
diary.day.bike.plain.0: Rode a bike. Wind in my ears.
diary.day.bike.plain.1: The bike squeaks, but it goes.
diary.day.bike.plain.2: Rode round half the town on a bike.
diary.day.radio.plain.0: Listened to the radio. «Lyudmilovsk Wave» played old songs again.
diary.day.radio.plain.2: Turned the radio dial, catching voices.
diary.day.paper.plain.0: Read the paper. Something is always happening in town.
diary.day.paper.plain.1: Leafed through «Lyudmilovsk Pravda». They lie about the weather.
diary.day.paper.plain.2: There was a notice in the paper that made me laugh.
diary.day.computer.plain.0: Sat at the computer in the club.
diary.day.computer.plain.1: Stayed too long at the computer again.
diary.day.computer.plain.2: The club computer hums like an old fridge.
diary.day.eat.many.1: Ate the same thing all day: {0} (×{1}).
diary.day.eat.plain.0: Ate. The food here is good.
diary.day.eat.plain.1: Was hungry as a wolf, but had a bite.
diary.day.weather.thunder.0: A thunderstorm. I counted seconds between the flash and the boom.
diary.day.weather.thunder.1: A storm blew in; the sky went green.
diary.day.weather.thunder.3: There was a storm. Afterwards everything smelled of iron and grass.
diary.day.weather.aurora.0: There was an aurora at night! Green curtains all over the sky.
diary.day.weather.aurora.1: The sky was glowing: an aurora. I couldn't believe my eyes.
diary.day.weather.aurora.2: Saw the aurora. Quiet and huge.
diary.day.weather.aurora.3: At night the sky shimmered. I think that's what an aurora is.
diary.day.weather.rainbow.0: After the rain there was a rainbow, right over the sea.
diary.day.weather.rainbow.1: A rainbow! Two, if you looked closely.
diary.day.weather.rainbow.2: First it poured, then a rainbow. A fair deal.
diary.day.weather.rainbow.3: Saw a rainbow. The whole town stopped to look.
diary.day.weather.snow.0: It snowed. The town went quiet and white.
diary.day.weather.snow.2: Snow fell all day. My nose froze.
diary.day.weather.snow.3: Snow piled up. You can see footprints from far away.
diary.day.weather.rain.0: Rain all day. My shoes never dried.
diary.day.weather.rain.2: Rain drummed on the roofs. It'd have been nice to stay in.
diary.day.weather.rain.3: A rainy day. The sea and the sky the same colour.
diary.day.weather.fog.0: Fog so thick you couldn't see the sea. Only hear it.
diary.day.weather.fog.1: Fog came in from the sea. People drifted out of it like ghosts.
diary.day.weather.fog.2: A foggy morning. The lamps were on in daytime.
diary.day.weather.drizzle.1: It spat with rain now and then.
diary.day.weather.drizzle.2: A fine drizzle; kept my hood up.
diary.day.weather.frost.0: Frost! Puffed steam like a locomotive.
diary.day.weather.frost.1: So cold my ears were ringing.
diary.day.weather.frost.2: A hard frost. The sea steams by the shore.
diary.day.weather.frost.3: An icy day. My fingers barely bend.
diary.day.weather.hot.0: Heat. Everyone at the beach, even the dogs.
diary.day.weather.hot.1: Scorching. The tarmac soft, ice cream melting faster than you eat.
diary.day.weather.hot.2: A hot day. All I wanted was the sea.
diary.day.weather.hot.3: The sun bakes. The town smells of hot dust.
diary.day.weather.clear.0: Clear, not a cloud. Sun all day.
diary.day.weather.clear.1: A clean sky. You could see far, far away.
diary.day.weather.clear.2: A sunny day. The sun felt somehow close today.
diary.day.weather.clear.3: Good weather. Even the gulls looked pleased.
diary.day.weather.cloudy.0: Overcast. The sky like a lid.
diary.day.weather.cloudy.1: A grey day, clouds hanging low.
diary.day.weather.cloudy.3: Cloudy and still. Good weather for thinking.
diary.day.weather.mixed.2: Clouds raced by, and their shadows down the streets.
diary.day.weather.mixed.3: Ordinary weather. Neither here nor there.
diary.day.quiet.0: Nothing special happened. Not bad either.
diary.day.quiet.2: Nothing to write today. Oh well.
diary.day.quiet.3: The day went by on its own.
diary.day.close.busy.0: What a day. I'll sleep like a log.
diary.day.close.busy.1: So much happened my hand is tired of writing.
diary.day.close.busy.2: A full day. Same again tomorrow, please.
diary.day.close.calm.0: Tomorrow will be a new day.
